title: billing.payment-allocated.v1
description: Money from a payment was applied to a posted invoice: by the rule at recording (oldest invoice first), by the rule when the order posted an invoice (from a held advance), or by hand under authority.
$comment: additionalProperties is true on purpose. conventions.md section 5.5 permits additive changes within a major version, so a subscriber must tolerate a field it has not seen; a closed schema would make every such addition breaking. required lists the fields present when v1 was published — a field added within v1 is optional forever, because a dead-lettered message replayed later carries the payload as it was written.

eventId.description: Identity of this occurrence. Delivery is at least once; consumers de-duplicate on it.

aggregateId.description: The payment the money came from.

allocationId.description: The allocation row: one application of one amount to one invoice.

advanceId.description: The advance the money was held in first, or null when it was applied at recording.

amount.description: How much was applied, to the paisa, in currency.

kind.description: How it came to be: the rule at recording, the rule on posting, or by hand.

schemaVersion.description: The payload's major version. Agrees with the .v suffix of eventType.
